description: Downloaded .nupkg files from NuGet API, extracted .dll, scanned binary for LowCode namespace strings in UTF-8 and UTF-16 encoding. This bypasses DllReflector entirely.
advantage_over_reflection: Does not require assembly resolution or dependency loading. Directly scans raw binary for namespace metadata strings.
limitation: Cannot discover API signatures or method details. Only confirms presence/absence of namespace.
conclusion: Binary string scan is sufficient to confirm LowCode absence. For families where LowCode IS present, full reflection is still needed for API catalog generation.
